description:
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!

 

As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.


Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!


What we’re looking for:

  • Build and contribute to open-source cloud infrastructure used across the Orange Group. You will work on Kubernetes controllers, Go/Python SDKs and the tooling around Project Sylva (Linux Foundation Europe), with real opportunities to contribute upstream to CNCF, Flux, Helm and the Kubernetes ecosystem.
  • Orange Telco Cloud runs in production across Orange subsidiaries in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, hosting telco network functions — and it keeps growing, with 5G Core workloads on the roadmap.
  • This is senior cloud-native software engineering — you write and ship code that other engineers run in production. The stack is Kubernetes, OpenStack, Helm, Flux CD and GitLab CI, built in Go and Python.
  • You split your time between building new features, hardening the production stack and contributing upstream.

 

What you'll be doing:

Build & ship:

  • Design, code and unit-test new modules in Project Sylva and the Orange Telco Cloud CaaS solution.
  • Own features end-to-end, from spec to merge.
  • Build CLI tools, Flux CD helpers and Helm chart utilities; author tests, linters and pre-commit hooks in CI.

 

Debug & harden:

  • Take ownership of production escalations, root-cause complex cases, ship patches.
  • Harden community-driven code before it hits production.
  • Embed security into the delivery pipeline (SBOMs, image scanning, signed artifacts) and keep clusters hardened — RBAC, network policies, admission controllers.

 

Open source:

  • Contribute upstream to open source projects and the Kubernetes ecosystem.
  • Keep forks in sync; backport fixes.


What you need to know / have:

  • Strong software development experience in Go or Python (one is enough)
  • Linux, Git, debugging and automated testing
  • API development and solid software engineering practices — CI, clear documentation
  • Hands-on Kubernetes beyond the user level — operators, CRDs, controllers; containers (Docker)
  • Helm chart authoring and GitOps in practice — Flux CD or Argo CD
  • Comfortable collaborating in the open — code reviews, clear writing, async communication

 

Nice to have (any one is a plus):

  • Contributions to CNCF / OpenStack / Project Sylva or related open-source projects
  • Professional experience with both Go and Python
  • Cluster API (CAPO, CAPBM / Metal3), multi-cluster management or OpenStack operations
  • Flux CD specifically, Kustomize, GitLab CI pipelines
  • Security tooling exposure — Kyverno, cosign, Trivy or NeuVector
  • Bare metal provisioning, SR-IOV, DPDK or telco networking background

 

Profile:

  • Senior: 5+ years building cloud platforms or distributed systems in production.
  • Deep Go or Python, fluent with the Kubernetes API.
  • Mentors the rest of the team.

 

The team:

  • An international team with colleagues in France, Romania and India, building Orange Telco Cloud for subsidiaries across Europe, the Middle East and Africa


What’s in it for you:

  • Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s;
  • Electronic Meal Tickets
  • Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;
  • #WFH & Flexible hours;
  • Professional GSM subscription;
  • Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];
  • Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;
  • Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;
  • Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen;

 

 

Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.

Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.

 

At Orange, you can.

 

IMPORTANT

In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.

 

 

We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
